source: DW, The Guardian, Reuters, CNBC, AP, WRGB

slides.headline: 5 things you probably missed on Nov. 23
slides.subline: **Chips, cyber deals, courts and cars.** Swipe for the quick version.

slides.body: Nvidia **reinstated Jensen Huang** as CEO despite a China espionage scandal, DW and The Guardian report. The Guardian says President Trump [[intervened]].
**CrowdStrike** agreed to buy **Zscaler** in an all-stock deal valued at about [[$43.9 billion]], Reuters and CNBC report.
**Tajikistan** announced it is leaving the International Criminal Court, Reuters reports. It is the [[fourth country]] to withdraw since a US diplomatic push.
New York’s governor signed a law barring fees to switch on [[car features already installed]], local outlets report.
**Honda** is recalling more than [[810,000 vehicles]] in the US over an airbag inflator issue, AP reports.
Which of these will matter most a year from now? Tell us below.
